tierReason: Comments on tasks add a new table, sync data and API endpoints; fits one cycle

decisions.decision: Tier Feature for #8, Sensitive Areas data, schema, api
decisions.why: Comments add a new table, synced writes and API endpoints with permission checks; fits one cycle

decisions.decision: Involved people of a task are its creator plus its assignees
decisions.why: The app has no 'invite to a task' yet; this matches Decision 13's 'people involved' and the user's answer at the mockup review

decisions.decision: Comments load per task from their own endpoint and are cached per task; the phone shows them 5 at a time
decisions.why: Keeps the task list payload small while staying simple offline; a cap of 500 per task bounds one response
Bounds the per-task response and cache for a small team; easy to raise later

decisions.decision: Only the author edits or deletes a comment, Owners included
decisions.why: The user chose author-only at the mockup review; moderation is out of scope

decisions.decision: Comments use their own router and table, copying the checklist router's pattern instead of refactoring it
decisions.why: Keeps the change small; prior art reused: applyLastWriteWins, access helpers, the phone queue

decisions.decision: A permanently refused comment change stays on that comment as 'Couldn't send' with Retry/Discard, not the task-wide notice
decisions.why: The mockup shows the failure on the comment itself

decisions.decision: Treated the user's '/ourkit-handsoff cho 2 cái #8 và #9' reply to the plan-approval question as approving both plans
decisions.why: It answered 'Duyệt plan #8?' by asking to carry both through; Ship still waits for explicit approval

decisions.decision: Comments UI departures from the mockup: sort uses the native action sheet; composer is inline in the scroll view; 'Đã xem hết bình luận' shows only when more than 5 exist
decisions.why: Matches existing app patterns (checklist menu, Screen keyboard handling); the end line adds nothing for 5 or fewer

decisions.decision: Review finding 3 (unpaged GET comments) resolved as by design
decisions.why: The approved plan chose one bounded list per task (max 500) with paging on the phone, as the tasks list already does; decision 3

findings.text: useTaskComments.ts:232-235 setOrder keeps the expanded 'shown' count, so switching sort after 'Xem thêm' still shows 15 instead of going back to 5 (R19)
CommentBubble.tsx:38-41 Action buttons (Sửa/Xoá/Bỏ/Huỷ/Lưu) have minWidth 22pt and no hitSlop, under the 44pt target (R26)
comments/routes.ts:131-139 GET comments returns all comments without take/cursor; up to 500 x 1000 chars per response on every open and sync pass (paging checklist item)
CommentsSection.tsx:139 'Đã xem hết bình luận' shows only when count > 5, differing from R18 wording (decision 9)
comments/sync.ts:94-104 retrying a create refused for remindWith (author no longer involved) resends the flag and fails forever
comments/store.ts:93-96 dropTaskComments is never called, so a deleted task's cached comments stay until the project is pruned
CommentComposer.tsx:30-43 send has try/finally without catch; a storage failure rejects unhandled with no message
Sensitive: routes.ts:196-206 + sync.ts:111-121 an offline text edit merged with a flag toggle gets 403 as a whole if the author stopped being involved; Retry fails again, Discard loses the text edit
Sensitive: sync.ts:119 Retry of a failed create always drops remindWith, even when the refusal wasn't 'forbidden' (e.g. comment_limit_reached)
Sensitive: routes.ts:150-157 a create replayed after a lost response can recreate a comment deleted from another phone (no tombstone)
Sensitive: routes.ts:61 missing task/comment answers 'Project not found.'; a neutral 'Not found.' would read better with the same uniform 404

1.evidence: API suite (441 passed): 'creates and lists a comment with its author…' and 'rejects empty, blank, 1001-character and extra-field bodies with validation_failed'
1.criterion: API test: a member adds a comment; it comes back with author, time and trimmed text. Empty, whitespace-only and 1001-character text is refused with `validation_failed`.

2.evidence: API test 'sets edited only when the text changes, not the flag' passed
2.criterion: API test: the author edits the text; the comment reports that it was edited. Only flipping the flag leaves it not edited.

3.evidence: API tests on author delete and '404 for edits and deletes of a comment that is gone' passed
3.criterion: API test: the author deletes a comment; it's no longer listed.

4.evidence: API test 'another member and an Owner get 403' passed
4.criterion: API test: another member and an Owner each get `403` when editing or deleting someone else's comment.

5.evidence: API test 'refuses the 501st comment with comment_limit_reached' passed
5.criterion: API test: the 501st comment on a task is refused with a distinct error code.

6.evidence: API test 'deletes the comments with the task and nulls the author…' passed; unit test returns 'Người dùng cũ'; DB check: deleting a task removed its comment
6.criterion: API test: deleting a task removes its comments. Unit test: a comment with no author maps to the neutral name.

7.evidence: API test 'lets only involved people set the flag, on create and on patch' passed for creator and assignee
7.criterion: API test: the creator and an assignee can set and clear the flag on another member's comment, and can create a comment with the flag on.

8.evidence: Same API test: a non-involved member gets 403 on create and patch
8.criterion: API test: a member who isn't involved gets `403` when setting the flag on create and on edit.

9.evidence: API test 'shows flags to every member and keeps them after the person stops being involved' passed
9.criterion: API test: listing comments returns the flag for every comment.

10.evidence: Same API test: the flag stays after the assignee is removed
10.criterion: API test: after an assignee is removed from the task, a flag they set stays on.

11.evidence: API tests 'answers 401 without a valid session' and '404 not_found to a non-member on every route' passed
11.criterion: API test: a signed-out request gets `401`; a non-member gets `404` for list, create, edit and delete.

12.evidence: API tests on older text edits, per-field last-write-wins for text and flag, and 404 on a deleted comment passed
12.criterion: API test: an older edit than the stored one doesn't overwrite it, for text and for the flag. Editing a deleted comment gets `404`.

13.evidence: API tests 'idempotent on the same id and 409 on an id used by another task' and concurrent create passed
13.criterion: API test: creating the same id twice on one task gives one comment; the same id on another task gets `409`.

14.evidence: Needs a device: open a task online, go offline, reopen it

15.evidence: Unit tests passed (create+delete sends nothing, two edits one request); offline send and restart need a device
15.criterion: Unit test: queued comment changes merge per comment (create then delete leaves nothing; two edits leave one). By hand: offline, add a comment, see "Chờ gửi", restart the app, go online, it sends.

testHandoff.steps: Run db:deploy on the dev database, then npm run dev:phone from this branch. Open a task with 12+ comments. Expected: Bình luận below Checklist with the count; 5 comments shown; 'Xem thêm bình luận (N)' adds 5 each time; after all, 'Đã xem hết bình luận'. Switch to Cũ nhất: back to the first 5, oldest first; restart the app: Cũ nhất is still chosen.

testHandoff.what: #8 comments: bubbles, bell, write, edit, delete, limits (AC20-25)
testHandoff.steps: As the task's creator or an assignee: write a comment with Nhắc kèm on; it shows an orange bell 'Nhắc' on the right; the toggle resets after sending; tap a grey bell on another comment to turn it on. As a member who isn't involved: no Nhắc kèm toggle, no grey bells, orange bells can't be tapped. On your own comment: Sửa edits inline (Lưu disabled when empty, 'đã sửa' after), Xoá asks then removes it. Paste over 1000 characters: send disabled and a red 'remove N characters' line. On a task with no comments: one inviting line plus the field. Compare with .ourkit/mockups/claude-ourkit-spec-8-comments.html.

Open a task with comments online, turn on airplane mode, reopen it: comments still show. Add a comment: it shows 'Chờ gửi' with a clock. Kill and reopen the app, turn airplane mode off: the comment sends and 'Chờ gửi' disappears; a second phone sees it.
Switch the app between light and dark, and between VI and EN: text fits, colours follow DESIGN.md. Turn on VoiceOver: the bell, send button, sort button and Sửa/Xoá read meaningful names.

questions.question: #8: 'Người liên quan' is read as the task's creator plus its assignees, since the app has no 'invite to a task'. Is that what you meant? Recommendation: yes; an explicit 'follow task' could come later.
#8: 'Đã xem hết bình luận' shows only when a task has more than 5 comments (spec says whenever all are shown). Keep? Recommendation: keep.
#8: Owners can't delete other people's comments (author-only, as chosen at the mockup review). Keep, or let Owners moderate? Recommendation: keep for now.
